projection: structures: screen = (gx, gy - z), origin = anchor; vehicles: straight down, facing north, pivot = frame centre

ironclad.note: a boat: the treads frames are its paddle wheels; draw them under the body and cycle them while it moves

barge.note: like the truck: swap the two frames while it moves (the bow wave and wake shift: it bobs)

railTrain.note: a 384 frame (a train is long; the other bosses are 288). treads = its wheels: draw under the body, swap the two frames while it moves (the coupling rods swing half a crank turn). Rings sit on the centre line (MOUNTS in dev/pixel/snow/train.py); fortressRail is the boss rail gun turret

harvester.note: a 320 frame (its felling head reaches past the 288 of the other bosses). treads = its two track units AND its two felling saws: draw them under the body and swap the two frames while it moves (links move half a link, the saws turn half a tooth; swap them faster when it rams). Rings: the fortress cannons on sponsons, the boss rail gun (fortressRail) amidships, the MG at the brow (MOUNTS in dev/pixel/forest/harvester.py)

sandstorm.note: straight-alpha haze; tile it over the view, drift it (say +40, +12 px/s) and fade it in during a storm

fog.note: straight-alpha swamp mist; tile it over a fog bank (mask it to the bank, soft edge), drift it slowly (say +10, +3 px/s)

blizzard.note: straight-alpha driving snow, its streaks running from upper right to lower left: tile it over the view in two layers (one at 1x drifting fast along the streaks, say -200, +260 px/s, one scaled 2x, slower and fainter) and fade it in during a blizzard

shafts.note: straight-alpha warm sun shafts and haze slanting down from the upper left: tile it over the view in a forest (additive or normal blend, ~0.6 opacity), drift it very slowly (say +4, +2 px/s); fade it out at night or in smoke

flamer.note: a jet pointing right (+x), nozzle at the anchor; rotate it to the gun, stretch along x to the range

burningReeds.note: flames standing on the ground; anchor = their foot; play over a burning reeds clump

wake.note: foam churn at the anchor, wake streaks trailing to -x; anchor at the stern or a paddle wheel, rotate so -x points astern

laserBeam.note: an instant beam strip pointing right (+x), even along x: stretch (or tile) it along x from the muzzle to the hit, rotate it to the shot; anchor = its centre line; flicker through the frames while it shows

laserHit.note: one-shot spark where a beam hits; anchor = the hit point

iceBreak.note: one-shot: cracks race out, the ice shatters and the water splashes; anchor = the middle of the hole; play when thin ice gives way under a Heavy (then show the hole / water ground there)

treeFire.note: a blazing tree canopy: a heap of flame tongues, embers and dark smoke rising (84 x 152). Loop it over a burning tree; anchor = the middle of the blaze, so put it on the canopy centre (about the tree's anchor minus 0.55 of its height in y); scale ~0.6 for young trees. When it burns out, switch the tree to its state 0 (oldTree / oldFir: a charred snag with embers)
